review_text: Fraudsters! The company does not comply with Danish law and provides no customer service. I bought 4 new tires three weeks ago, which were delivered by courier after a few days. When I unpack the tires, I notice large bulges and distortions in one of the tires. I immediately take pictures and send a written complaint to Grip500. They reject the complaint, claiming that there’s nothing wrong. According to them, the bulges and distortions will straighten out when the tire is mounted. I contact our local tire fitter, who has a different opinion. He believes there is a risk that the tire cannot be properly balanced due to the bulges and distortions. The same feedback comes from another local workshop. I write to Grip500 that we do not agree with their assessment, and I request a replacement tire. This is rejected, and I’m told that if I want to return anything, it will be at my own expense. I’ve now been arguing with them for nearly 3 weeks. They refuse to help and also won’t sell me a new tire as a replacement for the defective one. I have offered to have the tire mounted to see if they are right, with the understanding that they would send a new tire if they’re wrong. They simply refer to the fact that if the tire has been mounted, it can no longer be returned. Regardless of what we do, I have simply bought the 4 tires as they are, including the bulges and distortions. Their customer service is not Danish, so all communication from their side has been done through Google Translate. They have been downright rude and unpleasant in their language towards me as a customer. I cannot in any way recommend people to do business with them. ZERO stars from here. 17/11 my reply to grip500's reply : For real?? Please check my case and come back with a more serious answer. This standard bs answer is to no use at all.

Our assessment Incorrect and incomplete parts caused: Unnecessary extra work Repeated disassembly and assembly without progress Extra costs for the customer Delay in vehicle repair All additional costs could have been avoided if the parts had the correct specification and fit. Claim On behalf of the customer, we request that Autodoc: Refunds the additional cost of NOK 7,920 including VAT Or alternatively, refunds the cost of the incorrectly delivered/incomplete parts Documentation and work descriptions are attached. Conclusion We ask for your feedback as soon as possible, as well as information on how this matter is further handled. We are happy to assist with additional documentation if necessary. review_text: After posting this complaint, I was eventually contacted and reimbursed for the incompatible parts. However, after a few messages, the employee who had initially reached out to me appeared to stop responding, which forced me to contact the in-app support again. Only then was a warranty claim filed and my money refunded. While I am grateful for the resolution, I remain concerned about the way it was handled. The company referred to this outcome as a ‘gesture of goodwill.’ In reality, complying with consumer protection law is not goodwill—it is a legal obligation. What troubles me most is that, instead of straightforward assistance, I personally had to spend a great deal of time researching laws, studying specific legal articles, and presenting them to prove that I had the right to a refund. I appreciate the final resolution, but the process was unnecessarily time-consuming, frustrating, and placed the entire burden on me as the customer. Order number: 119912765 Order date: 10.09.2024 I am extremely disappointed with Autodoc’s customer service and their refusal to take responsibility for an incorrect part selection. All my previous orders for my Honda Accord 8 (VIN: JHMCU35809C203590) were always placed through Autodoc’s support team, never by myself. I always relied on their staff to provide the correct parts. However, in this case Autodoc now falsely claims that I ordered the parts on my own without their involvement, which is absolutely not true. The lower control arms that I received do not fit my vehicle. This is a clear case of “Sachmangel” under §434 BGB (German Civil Code) — the goods do not conform to the contract, as they are not suitable for the intended purpose. According to §439 BGB, in such cases the seller is obliged to provide a correct replacement or a full refund, and also to compensate the customer for costs of removal/installation. Instead, Autodoc is trying to hide behind a 14-day return period, which is irrelevant here. The 14-day return policy only applies to voluntary returns. When the goods are not as described or do not match the contract due to the seller’s mistake, the time limit does not apply — this is confirmed by EU consumer law (Directive 1999/44/EC and Directive (EU) 2019/771 on consumer sales and guarantees). In other words: •	The parts were selected incorrectly by Autodoc staff (as in all my previous orders). •	The parts do not fit — this is legally a non-conforming good. •	Autodoc must provide a replacement or refund under BGB §§434–439 and EU Directive 2019/771. •	Refusing support and shifting blame onto the customer is a breach of EU consumer rights. I am now forced to escalate this case to the European Consumer Centre (ECC-Net) and file a formal complaint. This whole experience has shown me that Autodoc’s customer support is unwilling to take responsibility when their own mistake causes problems for the buyer. ⚠️ Buyers beware: if Autodoc makes a mistake in selecting your parts, they will try to deny responsibility and hide behind irrelevant “return policies.”

review_text: I ordered some parts from AUTODOC and when they arrived in the UK at the EVRI parcel delivery depo, the EVRI tracking system told me “This parcel is bigger than we expected, so a specialist Evri courier will need to deliver it.” So it is coming up to 5 days that the parcel has been with EVRI, and I am still waiting to hear when my parcel is going to be delivered. I contacted AUTODOC told them the parcel was oversized.   AUTODOC said “It is very unlikely that the package was oversized. All parts are inside normal package 750x200x950”. I have confirmed with EVRI and their size limit is “Add together the 2 shortest sides and multiply it by 2. Then add the length. If the total is less than 245cm, your good to go”. So doing this with the dimensions AUTODOC gave me for my parcel (750x200x950) the calculation would be 200 +  750 = 950.   Then 950 x 2 = 1900. Then take the 1900 + 950 = 2850!   A total of 2850mm shows this parcel is over the EVRI size limit of 2450mm. So it is oversized for EVRI based on AUTODOC’s own admissions. EVRI also tells parcel senders “If your parcel is Overweight or Oversized then we’ll send the additional costs on to the sender and keep the parcel until we receive payment”. In addition, this plastic cover (part) is loose and moves up and down when touched - this means that the plastic cover does not sit properly anymore. I handed over my car to replace the windshield since I read good review about car glass but not to damage the inner plastic cover of my premium car. I have attached the picture in the other email I sent to (socialmedia at carglass dot de) with the number plate and my contact details. Since the crack occurred when changing the windshield, it is requested to replace the plastic cover immediately and also to fasten it correctly so that it no longer moves up and down on touching. I am disappointed. Please respond to me asap how you are going to tackle this issue so I can follow up on it and respond to you legally. Update from 21Aug 2024: Herr Wahl from Carglass Unterhaching installed a new part free of cost. Thanks Herr Wahl for your help and updates.

And to top it all off the casting failed on removal. Wish I could upload the pictures here. UPDATE: Ridex and Autodoc were both actually awesome when it came to CS. Like proper 5 star CS, they reached out to me, emailed & called me, processed a refund under warranty claim and paid me the refund same working day! I would happily use Autodoc for parts again. After a week, the status was still unchanged, therefore I contacted DHL itself, explaining the whole situation and sending them the DHL letter (with no date, no name on it…)… DHL could only confirm that the parcel had simply not been given to them by the seller … Then I contacted the seller to confront him with this opposite information. A long chains of mails followed. The answers were very quick, but in summary, he could only repeat over and over again the same thing, ie I had to read again and better the information he had already given me and that he should not be hold responsible of DHL delay (which is false). I could also feel that answers were becoming more aggressive. I wanted to use my right to cancel the order within 14 days, according to the german laws, but that was rejected again (which goes against german laws). Based on DHL reaction and seller’s attitude, I escalated the situation to Paypal and Rakuten. Rakuten reacted very quickly and contacted the seller. I guess that by seeing some higher authorities were getting involved, then he finally decided to cancel the order, so I got reimbursed. However, I’m convinced that I would have received neither the device, nor the reimbursement if I had bought the device directly to this shop… I saw in some other reviews that the seller threatened some people having put a negative review about him of legal actions, so I guess that I will get a quick reaction too, let’s see… So much fuss and stress… I would recommend to anyone to avoid any risk and to buy in another shop… (which I do and got the device 2 days after…)

The shop looks good, there are a lot of items, and the prices seem to be reasonable. My inquiry was answered quickly, so my first impression was good. Therefore I felt confident when I bought a bundled naviceiver and some tool, and the package was delivered within few days. So far so good. Unfortunately the item didn't fulfill my expectations due to several problems related to the integration with my car, so I decided to return the item. At that time, I had been testing the item for less than a week: I got the item on September 26th, did a test-installation in my car on the 29th, and on October 4 I made the decision of returning it. So I sent an e-mail to the shop telling them, that I needed to return the item (according to my Right of Withdrawel within the EU and especially Germany). From the date of reception (September 26th) until the date where I informed the shop about my decision of returning the item (October 4th) I counted 8 days. So I didn't expect any problems because it was within the period of 14 days. But the first answer I got from the shop, was that the date of return was already expired! Say what?! I didn't understand that. So I informed them about the issues I have with the item, and the reason for returning it, but the shop wrote that it wasn't their mistake, and instead I should contact the importer/manufacturer. Of course the shop was right about that the issues were not their mistake. But it was irrelevant, since I just wanted to return the item. So I kept writing that I needed to return it and I also guaranteed, that the item was kept in a perfect condition. But it didn't help – although they replied my e-mail everytime, my specific request was completely ignored without further comments! Telling the shop, that I then had to give them the lowest rating and sharing my bad experience with other people, the shop informed me about if I didn't withdraw my "False allegations", then they would involve their lawyer. False allegations?? Again I don't understand. I am just telling about the facts and my experience, like most Internet shoppers do. Lesson learned: I cannot trust this shop anymore because they let me down since they ignored my Right of Withdrawel. If you are not 100% sure about an item and might need to return it, then I definetely cannot recommend buying it at this shop!

supplier_response: Dear Thomas G., thank you very much for your feedback and for taking the time to share your experience with us. We're pleased to hear that you were satisfied with the ordering process and the efficient delivery — it's always our goal to ensure a smooth experience for our customers. We exclusively offer brand-new tires from current production. However, since the tires are dispatched directly after your order depending on availability from various warehouses across Germany, the specific DOT number of a given tire cannot be determined in advance due to system constraints. Please note that, over time, proper storage can actually improve certain material properties. This is because the rubber compound in the tires continues to cure and is not immediately exposed to the stresses of road use. According to the BRV (German Tire Retail and Vulcanization Trade Association), tires are considered "factory-new" for up to 3 years and "new" for up to 5 years, provided they have been stored correctly. We appreciate your honesty and your 3-star rating, and we hope to welcome you again in the future under even better circumstances. Kind regards Reifendirekt Team

Few months ago I purchased a product on eBay from ATP Autotelie, now it broke because of a clear defect (it broke in two parts), and due to its breakage I was close to get my car engine completely burned. I had to spend more money to replace the defective product on an emergency basis, with a lot of time waste. Not even three months were passed, so the product was and still is under purchase warranty coverage, which is defined by the UE Council directive 85/374/CEE of 25th July 1985. However, ATP Autotelie has blocked all ways to contact them or rise any kind of issue. Therefore, I tried try to assert my customer rights through the PayPal claiming system, but the seller invented the excuse that somehow I “altered” the product, which is clearly false and can be easily verified from the picture I sent them. Anyway, PayPal decided to support the fraud and rejected my claim. The matter does not end here, I am reporting what happened (all of which can be proven with documentation in hand) first here on TrustPilot, and then I am turning to a consumer defense association to take legal action, not only against the seller but also against PayPal. This is not so much for an economic problem, but because people cannot be defrauded in this way, it is a question of principle and a question of law, both national and European community laws. **** Update **** After the review was published on TrustPilot, I was contacted by ATP Autoteile, unlocking the possibility to message them on eBay messaging system (but why it was blocked, nobody said). They behaved like they didn't know anything about the claim, that looks quite suspicious to me: did eBay arbitrarily take the initiative to reject my complaint without even informing the seller and without any reasoning? Let's take this as the truth, since the level of eBay service is so poor that can actually arrive at this point. After this, they formally apologized (formally) and accepted to refund the faulty product (except shipping costs), without wanting the broken product back. Then. we had days and days of endless email exchange to undergo the steps of the refund process, several their emails were also sent me twice from different email address. If I could count all the time I lost to reply and send all the information they asked, probably I had to receive three-four times the due amount, but probably this was exactly the idea under such behavior. Obviously I just received the refund of the faulty product (except shipping costs), that is already a huge step on towards the right direction, but the experience was so frustrating that I cannot avoid helping others to avoid my same mistake.

review_text: I’m pretty sure that this review makes no difference to ATP or my case, but hopefully people will think twice before buying anything from this company. I purchased a Sachs clutch kit from ATP, for my Audi A4. The payment and delivery went fine and quick, which is probably the only positive thing I have to say about this company. We had scheduled a repair at a local mechanic for a gearbox and clutch replacement, so we delivered the ATP clutch as per agreement to the mechanic. However, when the mechanic went to fit the new clutch to the car, he noticed that the clutch didn’t fit and was actually a LUK clutch (completely different brand to Sachs). The clutch was branded LUK on one side and Sachs on the other. As the car was taking up space on a lift and the mechanic couldn’t wait for a new clutch to be delivered, we had to buy the correct clutch locally. Unfortunately it didn’t come with a clutch release bearing, so we had to use the one supplied with the clutch kit from ATP. I called ATP and explained the situation (in German, as apparently only one or two ATP employees speaks English) and asked if it was possible for me to return the incorrect clutch without the bearing, to which they replied yes. I returned the clutch as agreed, and for a long period of time I heard nothing from them, so I decided to call them to see if they received the clutch. After a couple of calls, they informed me that they had in fact received the clutch, but that the bearing was missing and that they could not refund me as the set was not complete. I tried to explain the situation several times with no luck and no sympathy. ATP sells the exact clutch release bearing on their website and I informed them, that I would happily pay for the bearing that I had used from the kit, so they could replace it in the kit. But for some reason this is impossible to do for ATP. In theory I could just get the clutch back, buy the bearing, put it in the box and return a complete set. I have now spent several hours on the phone, trying to first of all get through to them on the phone, which is a nightmare. And when I finally manage to get through, nobody speaks English (fortunately I speak a little German). The employees that answer the phone cannot make any decisions and needs to speak to their supervisors and promises to call back, which they NEVER do, so you have to start all over every time you get through to them. To make things even better, now ATP wants me to pay them to return the wrong clutch to me.

After a every email they promised me to send the missing parts within a few days. But they didn't. Tried to call them but could not reach them. (Tried it 17 times one afternoon, they put you on hold and then disconnect after 5-10 minutes waiting.) So brought the car to garage where they welded the catalytic converter to the exhaust system. To my surprise, after 10 weeks or more, I got without any warning the missing parts in the mail! Thanks! Real sad company, they don't even try to help their customers!

review_text: "no risk 90 day money back guarantee". Yeah sure. Bought a Chinese made A/C compressor for my Mercedes from them. It leaked badly. Not because it was broken or something. The design was bad and impossible to  create a sealed system. Sent the unit back. They made every single excuse you could imagine - I hadn't given them a chance to fix the problem, so no warranty (I did  they answered no questions about making the product actually work). - I didn't include the original mechanic's invoice - (I did, right on top of the compressor) - They inspected the thing and claimed  there was no proof of the defect occuring before the installation (simply, the replacement part was of a bad design - didn't work before, didn't work after, despite trying many things to prevent having to pay to uninstall and then install a different one) - The invoice didn't show what they needed to see - no warranty (my Italian speaking mechanic hardly understands what I ask him in english, however, I made sure he did the job right - flushing, replacing the drying unit, etc.) In short, they kept the part (probably re-sold it) and kept the money also! Edited October 25, 2018: ATP tried hard to remove this review about a year ago. Fortunately, after trustpilot looked at the evidence, this review remained. Don't be fooled by the feeble bluff of an offer to resolve the issue more than two years after the fact. Do yourself a favour and listen to my and all others' experience in buying cheap, poorly made non-functional parts and purchase your car parts from a reputable source. Otherwise, we told you so. My mistake cost me 179 euros for the compressor plus nearly 300 euros extra for my mechanic's huge efforts to try to make the thing work and then remove it and replace it with a unit from Mercedes.

review_text: 🇫🇷 Français Lors de ma première expérience, j’ai rencontré certains problèmes. Même si le processus a pris du temps, mon souci a finalement été résolu, ce qui m’a satisfait. À l’avenir, je pourrais envisager de faire de nouveau des achats sur votre site. Cependant, pour renforcer la confiance et éviter ce type de désagrément, il serait très utile d’intégrer un système permettant d’enregistrer le numéro de châssis des véhicules. En effet, le fait de se baser uniquement sur la marque, le modèle et l’année ne semble pas suffisant. L’ajout d’une recherche par numéro de châssis, ainsi que la possibilité d’associer ce numéro à un véhicule enregistré, permettrait de réduire considérablement les erreurs de compatibilité, même si une compatibilité à 100 % ne peut jamais être totalement garantie. Si une telle fonctionnalité est mise en place, je serais tout à fait disposé à continuer mes achats sur votre plateforme. J’espère sincèrement que ce type de problème ne se reproduira pas à l’avenir. Merci à AUTODOC pour la résolution de mon problème. NOTE: De plus, j'accède à votre site web via autodoc.be, et la langue par défaut devrait être le français, mais il s'ouvre constamment en néerlandais, ce qui est très agaçant :) --------------- 🇬🇧 English During my first experience, I encountered some issues. Although the process took some time, my problem was eventually resolved, and I appreciate that. In the future, I would consider shopping on your website again. However, to improve reliability and prevent similar issues, it would be highly beneficial to implement a system that allows customers to register their vehicle’s chassis (VIN) number. Relying solely on brand, model, and year appears to be insufficient. Adding a search option based on the chassis number, as well as allowing users to link this number to their saved vehicles, would significantly reduce compatibility errors—even if a 100% guarantee cannot always be ensured. If such a feature is implemented, I would be willing to continue using your platform for future purchases. I sincerely hope that similar issues will not occur again. Thank you to AUTODOC for resolving my case. NOTE: Also, I access your website via autodoc.be, and the default language should be French, but it constantly opens in Dutch, which is very annoying :)

supplier_response: Dear Sasha Green, Thank you for your review and our sincere apologies if there has been any confusion regarding import charges. The charges UPS has billed you are import duties for your parcel. Import duties have been charged for your parcel because we are based in the Netherlands and all parcels sent from the EU to the United Kingdom must now undergo customs checks and are subject to import duties. We have posted warnings in the checkout for all customers who select “United Kingdom” as their destination country when placing their order. The warning states that we are based in the Netherlands and that import duties are levied on all parcels sent to the United Kingdom. The costs are determined by customs and by UPS itself during the customs process. It is therefore not possible for us to know in advance what the costs will be, as we are not involved in the calculation process and each cost is unique to each parcel. We cannot waive or change the import duties, as this is beyond our control and is now mandatory under new trade laws between the United Kingdom and the EU. Furthermore, it is no longer possible to cancel or refund the order, as it has already been transferred to UPS. If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us. Kind regards, Etrias Customer Service

review_text: I have tried the trelino and it is really perfect. Good material, very practical to use and easy to clean up. I have received a damaged valve but the assistance immediately replaced it with a new one without additional costs. Expensive but very satisfied.

Evo S bought for long-term travel in camper van.  I thought I would only use this for emergencies.  In reality I use this toilet all the time.  Well, not all the time, but as much time as one could spend on a toilet.  Sitting on the seat, I realise how much thought, love, care and design work has gone into this product.  I started to notice little features that make my life easier, nicer and more comfortable - just yesterday I noticed that Trelino have made a soft-close lid.  So thankyou Trelino for making this part of my day a pleasure. Cost: it's definitely an investment but I plan to use this for at least five years, so on a PPP metric (Price Per Poo) it's really a bargain!

The Trelino is so great. No need to have problem where to empty the things. The liquid in the forest or the toilet on a gas station. The other thing I have so far brought home to our outdoor compost toilet. I am using it in a Camper van and in summer also in my boat.

Ok, Trelino is a bit more expensive than similar products, but don't hesitate, smooth easy to clean surface, comfortable seat, good hight and not to forget the soft closing lid. The last seemed just like "luxuary", but when someone is up in the night you don't want to wake up by a smash...✌️
Price and performance do not match. Lid rattles, handles missing... I wouldn't buy the Trellino again for this price. The design and the comfortable seating are positive.
supplier_response: Thank you for your feedback! The handles are an optional accessory and can be ordered separately. As for the rattling lid, this is not standard for our products, and we’d love to help find a solution. Please feel free to contact our support team at hello@trelino.com, and we’ll gladly assist you. Thank you for sharing your thoughts. Your satisfaction is important to us!

review_text: They are expensive for what they are. The finish on the lid was poorly manufactured. That said it was rectified by them offering a partial refund or replacement, which i received. The cost removed the stars down to 4 and the quality shifted it down to 3
supplier_response: Thank you for your honest feedback! We’re sorry to hear that the lid's finish didn’t meet your expectations initially, but we’re glad we could provide a resolution. Your comments about cost and quality are valuable to us, and we’ll use them to improve further. If there’s anything else we can do, please don’t hesitate to reach out!

review_text: It took me a while to click the button to purchase my Trelino. After all, it is very expensive for what it physically is. Even after receiving it, it took a while to start loving it compared to my previous van toilet with a flush. Also the height meant I had to adapt my technique. No more kneel down wee's. I had to instead embrace the sit down wee! I think that was probably my eureka moment. It is after all a comfortable thing to sit on! No flush required, instead I give it a few squirts with an antibacterial surface cleaner and job done. As far as using the 'back box', only done so twice but no dramas to report. In fact the sheer lack of drama is enough to warrant the price. Yes, I now love my Trelino 🥰

Our bathroom alterations are still on going not used our new compost toilet as yet. From placing our order it all went very smoothly efficiently and delivery was quick. Nandine from customer services kept in touch through out answering any questions we had and giving us advice. Very pleased with how modern, compact and well made out toilet looks. Would definitely recommend Trelino.

Fabulous and prompt service, including the delivery, and answering any questions I had about the most suitable product for us. The equipment itself is superb and does exactly what it says it will, ie odour free toilet experience that is far better than the stinking, and rather ghastly, chemical cassette thing, we replaced in our motor home.

Saw on YouTube people taking about Trilino as a camping toilet, particularly like the idea of number Ones & Tows being separate, & the fact that the toilet is small & compact box (with a toilet seat under the lid) that at first glance is not obviously a toilet, used on every van trip & fantastic for the whee hours wee….

Living on a Barge has it's challenges, and some I could happily live without. I had been using a cassette loo until I discovered Trelino. Horrible chemicals, stains on my lovely wooden floor, and a total disaster to empty. Now I have lovely, clean living, and smell free Trelino. So simple to set up, simple to empty, and can be tucked away when not in use....Trelino are such a lovely company to deal with too, so it's a win, win!

We got a small Origin toilet for our campervan and it's really good. It doesn't smell.and it allows us to adventure without the worry of finding a toilet or where to empty a cassette toilet.  It's quite expensive but well worth it.  It's looks good and is used as a seat when it's not stored away.

Just moved house and wanted a downstairs loo.  There was just the place, but I later found this involved moving the gas main, which sounded expensive.  So after much research, I decided to try the Evo L, which was the same height as the loo in my bathroom.  I'm 65 and I find the wee container, easy to take upstairs and empty, the loo easy to use, and no smell.  I love it!
Just brilliant 👏

I’ve just come back from 4 weeks of using this toilet so got to know it well you could say. Overall an excellent product and performs well, being the first time with this type of toilet I was really surprised that there is no odour and overall emptying and keeping clean were very very easy. I would absolutely recommend this over my previous chemical toilets. Couple of points, I’m not sure why it doesn’t just come with the handles, if you are going to be moving it for use say at night time it’s a good idea to have them, especially after the weight increase after a few days use. Obviously if you’re using it in a fixed position no need for them. They are an added extra!! My only disappointment is that the outer case appears to mark quite easily, so need to be careful during travelling or ensure it’s covered. Still highly recommended 5 star, but remember the handles and casing needing to be covered ideally for travelling.

Once the decision had been made (my camper would only fit the Trelino S although I had fancied the DIY Eurobox as it could be stacked for a better seat height), I ordered online. Communication was good, delivery was on time and the product has exceeded expectations. My old chemical system is stored in the shed and every time I see it I'm glad I bought the Trelino. My intention is to use coffee grounds as compost medium and I now realise that I drink way more coffee than go away on camping trips. Still, I've got a supply for next year!

I am very happy with the service and politeness off the people that I had contact with, postage was very good and fast delivery I will use them again as and when I need camping stuff , the product what I purchased was very good I am very happy with there service
The whole experience of using the Trevino separator toilet is far superior to a conventional chemical toilet and no smell issues whatsoever. A great product which I can highly recommend.

Real game changer made staying in our van so much better no smelly toilet chemicals and searching for disposable emptying points. So easy to use and it’s comfortable we even use it as a seat. Great company to deal with. I have no problem in recommending this product.

Well made product and their team provide great service. We’re weekend warriors so overnight is our main use. Still working on finding the best litter, butt really happy so far and expecting to have a heirloom product worthy of passing on to future generations.(the boy will be surprised when he reads the will!)

This is a great option for a camp with no bathroom. Is it weird to scoop wood shavings over your poop? Yes, but it really does work as advertised! The biggest downside is the awkwardness of emptying the urine container.  It would be better if there was a more ergonomic design to pour out the liquid, instead it wants to stay in the sides and sloshes out over the handle. For two people we purchased the mid-sized Trelino Evo M and find that we need to empty the liquid container sometimes before nightfall, or else it spills inside the toilet. Knowing that, we would have gone for the larger sized container.
Easy to deal with.  Well made product
Works perfectly. No odors

We love the simple structure of this composting toilet and how easily cleanable it is!  We use ours in our tiny house and are composting Humanure style so used this way it is a truly no-waste product.  simple, easily cleaned and maintained, and we like the way it looks too!

We bought the Trelino  (middle model) in 2022.The only small criticism we could make is that the urine tank, due to its shape, always leaves a little urine (or water if rinsing) after emptying. Well, it is a minimal quantity but it does not dry quickly. However, we are fully satisfied with this product that we absolutely do not regret having purchased, even if the price may seem relatively expensive at first glance.

This is an essential product.  Very well made. The compact version fit great in our Sprinter Camper Van. We are a family of six.   Being out in Yosemite for a week, this thing came in handy. This is a great upgrade from our old home depot bucket. It was easy to maintain with almost no smell. I didn't have to worry about it tipping over during the long drive. The natural wood top version aesthetically fit our van perfectly. I love how everything is self contained within the unit.

Wow everything about our Trelino toilet has been a game changer versus the other brands we had. Love the fact the poo goes out in a plastic (recyclable) bag. Rip out our NH and haven’t looked back in two years.

The Trelino composting toilet is exactly as advertised and it is exactly what we needed. It is the right size to work with our roof top tent in which we locate it inside a vestibule. It changed the whole experience. It is compact and light but exceptionally well designed and constructed. The separator works very well and maintenance is easy and trouble free. I would buy this again.
Product is really awesome...the week point is the price! A new "life style" should be near the possibilities of everyone to grow,i guess.

My previous portable toilet was a cassette type which was frankly ghastly to use and empty (ie smelly and messy) to the point I hated using it and avoided it if at all possible. It also used chemicals which were pretty unpleasant too and it was heavy to move about. I've used the Trelino for the last 2 months and it is very solid but lightweight, pleasant to use, with no mess, no smell and no hassle. Solids and liquids are kept separate and it's easy and convenient to use. The only downside is that it is a bit expensive to buy but I'm so glad I bit the bullet and made the purchase.

A brilliant accessory for camping “off grid”! Works exactly as advertised! Would very much recommend! Looking forward to when Trelino’s sawdust becomes available to the UK market. (But I was able to get the next thing on Amazon - which still works very well). Looking forward to many more totally independent and free camping experiences with my Trelino!🤩🤩 The Trelino Team also extremely helpful and quick to respond to questions before and after my purchase!

I purchased a Trelino Evo L toilet in 2023, seeking an alternative to chemical toilets without water connections. This product is both ingenious and fantastic! Trelino’s commitment to eco-friendly solutions is evident in the design and quality of their toilets. Highly recommended! Thank you Trelino!

the main fault is condensation. the urine vapors remain locked in the toilet and the smell is unpleasant when opened. the second fault is the groove at the bottom of the toilet which is very difficult to clean. Finally, women find it difficult to sit properly separating solid and liquid.
Useful and solid. A gauge for the pee will be really helpful
Seat not super confortable, but this is still ok. The biggest problems is urine tank, not easy to empty, always some left in tank…
Great quality, very happy with our Trelino toilet

The toilet system comes as the most cost effective DIY package, offering an effective design for hygiene and ease of use. I also found the staff of Trelino friendly and helpful, which is essential when dealing with human waste manage. Definitely a cost effective product.

Trelino is a high quality and sustainable product, easy to keep clean. No more pollution and chemicals. No more time spent in campervan charging stations to unload dirty water. Definitely vanlife-changing! :)
Things I like - design and sturdiness Things I don't like - super smelly plastic, it stinks very bad also when it's empty - assistance
supplier_response: Thank you for your feedback! We're glad you appreciate the design and sturdiness of the product, but we’re sorry to hear about the issue with odours. To address the smell, we recommend cleaning the container thoroughly with a diluted vinegar solution. This helps neutralise odours effectively. Avoid using just water for cleaning, as it can lead to limescale or urine deposits over time. If you have further concerns or need additional assistance, please feel free to contact our support team—we’re happy to help!

review_text: It fits perfectly for my size of van. I have the small size.  I only use it for night time.  I do find that sometimes with the small size, the liquid container needs a bit more width at the top.  It doesn't catch all of the liquid.  I have an idea to add a bit more.  It might not be an issue with a younger person.  I'm an oldster.
Great company with great products!  We have been really satisfied with our toilet, nearly as comfortable as our home toilet :)  It is also high quality and will last for years of use.

Hello, I have used the Trelino separating toilet a lot for 6 months. It is I good toilet and easy to use. It is usable in all temperatures, so I am able to winter camp and still have a toilet. I recommend it for solo travelers or couples who have been together a long time. You are up close and personal with your poo. If you are positioned a little off, you have to clean poo off the seat. My complains are as follows. The instructions say to use vinegar for cleaning. I could not get rid of the pee and poo smell with vinegar. I have to use bleach to soak out the urine scale and smell in the blue container. Also getting the smell off the toilet seat requires a lot of bleach water. I just purchased a new to me class B. I will try the flush toilet again. I will keep the Trelino  as a back up toilet for my one bathroom house. If I get tired of the black tank dumping again, I may install the Trelino again. I recommend this toilet highly.

I'm very pleased with my choice of Trelino.  Composting feels right and this unit enables me to easily keep my bathroom area clean and efficient. I'd have no reason to investigate alternative options.
Simple design, good color, ease of use

I would not buy it again but construct something myself. The container for the pee is in general great but sooo hard to empty totally due to its form. Actually i find it super expensive… the cube for the bigger things i could get for 2€ myself… it is neither possible to leave the hard stuff there as it smells way too much… so i regret that i bought it to me honest. Sorry
supplier_response: Thank you for your honest feedback! We’re sorry to hear that your experience didn’t meet your expectations. The urine container’s design prioritises splash-free use, but we understand that its shape might make emptying a bit tricky. I will forward your feedback to our development team. For odour issues: - Please ensure that the solids container is completely dry before use and add a layer of litter as a base. - Use the recommended type of litter to fully cover solids after each use. - If the container has absorbed odour over time, a deep clean with a diluted vinegar solution or citric acid can help. We appreciate your thoughts on the price—we strive to offer high-quality, durable, and ethically made products, but we understand this might not meet everyone's expectations. If you’d like to discuss further or explore solutions, please don’t hesitate to reach out. Thank you for sharing your experience!

review_text: The transaction was easy, the product matches the description, and absolutely serves our needs.

Overall the product has exceeded my expectations. Coming from other brands that has complicated set up and disposal, Trelino is hands down simple, functional, and easy to use. Now, there is one thing that I think needed some improvement on the urinal side; the container, when disposing it’s content there is no ample traction to hold on to. Holding the handle while pouring the content gets to an angle where it kinda restrict to completely empty the container. I have to hold the container on both sides while pouring the content out and because the top of the container is flat is another reason you really need to tilt it from side to side to empty it completely. Pretty much go through the same process when rinsing it. Now, I’m no engineer but had the top part of the container had a slight cone like shape to it it may help with easier emptying. Just a thought ; )

I've owned my Trelino Evo L since December 2023. We used it on a 6 week cross country trip from NY to CA. It is a game changer, in terms of ease of use, quality, and simplicity. I would call it a separating toilet, and not a composting toilet, as there's no way while traveling that  solid wastes will actually compost. But it does its job well, with minimal odor and almost no maintenance. Is it expensive? Yes it is. Perhaps it is overpriced, but there isn't anything else available that can complete with it, and still check off all of its qualities. I had a minor issue requiring CS, and Trelino handled it to my complete satisfaction.

Really like the opportunity to block off the black tank in my Airstream trailer. No more really stinky slinky! The Trevino toilet fits in a relatively small space, and, if used per instructions, doesn't smell. I use cedar shaving which are easy to find in bulk. I do use a small urine bottle most of the time at night so I don't have to sit down, but the Trevino urine collection bottle works well.

Great company and great products!!! I purchased the Evo M composting toilet for our small camper van. This thing is AWESOME!! Seriously in love with my toilet. It's lightweight and easy to move around and clean. Total game changer while traveling and camping. I cannot recommend this product and company enough!

This is hands down the best portable toilet money can buy. It literally has everything you need, nothing that you don't. It is easy to clean, discreet and did I mention it is easy to clean. This has revolutionized our camping experience...I will never look back!

These composting toilets are AWESOME!  I have to admit that I was skeptical.  Just over a year ago I bought a stationary travel trailer and had no desire to deal with the black tank.  I looked at options and Trelino intrigued me.  I took the leap and ordered the large Evo Model.  I tore the old toilet out of the trailer, sealed the tank, and set the Trelino in its place.  We used it full time for a month solid.  I emptied the urine tank and the composting section about every three days.  It NEVER smelled!  It was FAR better than ANY RV toilet I have ever been around.  I was shocked.  I was so thrilled that I ordered the Medium Evo and tore the toilet out of my Class B van and installed one in there as well.  And it has been a HUGE upgrade in the van.  No more dumping, no more black tank, and no more stink!  Great product.  Great company.  Great move on your part if you get one!

I had a pleasant experience using the well laid out web site to review and make my purchase decision. The package arrived promptly and well packaged to avoid shipping damage. I wanted to get in some use before writing a review. Overall I am pleased using this toilet for just about a month now. It isn't real hard to adapt to the operation.

Everything you need, and nothing you don't need! Fellow campers (especially small trailer and van campers), this is what you have been looking for. Its an ingenious solution to a need we all have. I no longer use any of the other portable toilets that I own in favor of this minimalist solution. Signed: Happy Camper

Great size, easy to use toilet which fits perfectly in our VW T2 bus. The separate compartments make cleaning and emptying the toilet a breeze, and despite it being small, my chunky thighs have no problem!

This is a great toilet. We came from a dometic flushing toilet which was horrible.  the flushing feature uses water, which is finite, and causes your urine to crystallize in the tank.  the trelino separator is a great design and everything about it is great.  the thing i think is worth a re-design is the urine tank.  The lid and spout are flat so that when you dump it, it won't fully empty.  I think having a tapered neck to the lid would help drain it better.  It might lower the capacity of the tank but i don't think it will be meaningful versus being able to dump it fully.
We have tried multiple toilet options for our Four Wheel Camper overland setup. The Trelino is now our final setup. Easy of use, portable and build construction are spot on.
My partner and I live in our tiny home on wheels full time and the composting toilet from Trelino has made our lives that much easier.

First, the company is first rate with quick responses and excellent product. The Trelino toilet arrived on time, is made with quality and is strong and robust. It also looks sleek, and doesn’t need to be hidden away from sight, as it looks just like a storage or equipment box. It is extremely easy to set up and is very efficient in use. This is the only system that I would use, as it checks all the boxes. I would recommend this product unreservedly, as I think it is the best on the market.

I purchased this for my Four Wheel Camper. It fits perfectly under the rollover sofa. It's lightweight, easy to use, store and clean. It was well packaged and arrived fast. I've owned RVs with holding tanks and cassette toilets and this is absolutely the BEST solution. I got the small for 1 person and ease of carrying. I purchased in the U.S.

I want to love my Trelino toilet but, no matter what I do, it stinks! I've tried all types of sawdust and other 'litters' but, when that lid opens, it smells bad. I've been super careful to keep it totally clean but even the container itself stinks when there's nothing in it at this point. Long story short, I've had to resort to using a toilet tent instead of using it in the van as intended, thus the 3 star rating.
supplier_response: Thank you for your honest feedback! We're sorry to hear about the odour issues you’ve been experiencing. Here are a few tips: - Ensure that the solids container is completely dry before use and add a layer of litter as a base. - Use the recommended type of litter to fully cover solids after each use. - If the container has absorbed odour over time, a deep clean with a diluted vinegar solution or citric acid can help. - Additionally, ventilation or a small fan may help in a van setup to improve air circulation. Please reach out to our support team—we’d love to help you troubleshoot and find a solution so you can enjoy using your Trelino® as intended.

review_text: After rather extensive research on what toilet I was going to purchase for my new van build, I decided on the Trelino. I could not be happier with that decision. The Trelino has met all our expectations, and most importantly, my wife loves it. The the design is simple, does exactly what it is intended to do, is amazingly light, easy to dump, and it looks great. The product arrived well packaged, and the delivery time from order to arrival was excellent. I have recommended this toilet to several of my friends.

I purchased the Trelino Evo L in Mar. 2024 and it has proven to be a great product.  I purchased it to replace the existing traditional toilet that fills a black water tank in my new travel trailer.  The Trelino toilet requires no installation and has been great to use - and with no smells and no travel trailer black tank disposal mess with which to deal.  Replacing my existing travel trailer toilet was a breeze, just 2 screws to remove the toilet from the flange, disconnecting and plugging the fresh water line running to the toilet, and installing a piece of 3/4" plywood (approximately 20" by 20") on the floor, as a platform for the Trelino toilet, with a cutout hole around the travel trailer toilet flange, which I didn't remove, just in case the next owner wants to reinstall a traditional toilet.  Additionally, I have combined my travel trailer grey water tank and otherwise unused (thanks to Trelino) black water tank to give me more grey water storage capacity when camping away from hookups. Back to the Trelino toilet - I love the soft closing lid and durable one-piece design with a comfortable, ergonomically designed seat.  My wife and I use the Trelino in our travel trailer for weekend camping and at the end of the weekend, emptying both the urine container and solids container is very easy with no mess.  Replacing my traditional travel trailer toilet with a Trelino was so far my best decision of 2024!
Simple design, simple to use. Highly recommend!

I’ve been camping my whole life and have had a travel trailer with a flushing toilet and the “stinky hose” I’ve used a cassette toilet and now this composting toilet. The Trelino is the best and easiest out of all systems. No leaks and no smell if I use enough compost material. I can go three days on the “poo” but I have to change the urine daily. The only suggestion I could offer is a level indicator for the urine container might be helpful.
Small company with a great product. It’s “just” a moulded plastic toilet but the engineering and design make it remarkable.

Great design, easy to use and so compact.  I have this in my camper van and I love it.  The design is simple and easy to use.  Positioning is indeed everything here so just be mindful of where you're sitting in regards to what you're "doo"ing- lol.  I have the smaller one which is fine fir my needs but it sits a little low.  So I built a riser for it and it's great!

I was able to carry urine container,  (when I remembered to switch covers lol) to a public bathroom somewhere in a large canvas bag that passed as a camp shower bag. Nobody knew what was in it. Disposal of the poo waste bag was also easy and nobody knew. No bad smell either. I used loose coconut mulch so it was easy to use also. Good cleaning of everything when I got home. I’m so glad I got it.

It is just as I hoped it would be, very compact, well designed, easy to use.  When I place it in a “shower” tent next to my pop-up camper, I put it on something to elevate it, to make it easier to sit down and get up as it is quite low.
Excellent service. Excellent response to any questions, and a very well made product.

I looked around the market for a while. The traditional designs were big and awkward. Boxio looked too flimsy…. Trevino seemed like the perfect match for my van.  Great design, easy to use and maintain. 5/5

Nice sturdy toilet chosen for simplicity and looks. Used it on a 2 month road trip  mostly for urine and it works perfectly. Loved the night time convenience. I emptied it every other day and was simple to keep odor free. What else is there to say. It works great
Ordering was easy and prompt. I got the large one. I like the highth and it is stable and durable to sit on. Like the way it functions.

Everything Was Great! Company, Product And VERY GOOD FOR THE ENVIRONMENT! There Is A Lot Of Toilets For Van Life And Traveling.....But None Even Come Close To TRELINO...Ease Of Use, Space Saving, Economical And Not Near As Expensive As Most Other Models Or As Easy To Clean And Maintain!

We got the medium, I'm 6'2 and she's 5'2. Perfect for a weekend out. It doesn't stink and we use pine shavings. We carry an extra bucket with a spray bottle of vinegar/water and lavender oil, toilet paper and the shavings. Maybe they will someday make a stackable shavings/pellet container that the trelino will sit on. Great for both and we have it in a car on the ride home. No problemo on the stinko
Excellent company, excellent products, and they just do what they're intended to do. One of the best purchases I've made for living the van life.

The Trelino composting toilet is well-designed and convenient to have. We ordered the smallest one so it's easy to pack in the van to include in our tent camping. We haven't used it a lot, its for middle of the night trips or if the campground doesn't have clean and close toilets, but when used, there is no smell and it's very easy to clean. Arrived quickly and cleverly packaged.

I haven’t had one single problem with the compost toilet I bought.   I have it in an off grid cabin and is the perfect solution if you aren’t comfortable going in the woods!   I’m so glad I bought this and yes, you have to empty it and I bury the waste in the compostable bags - I bought extra- but so what?!   Feeds the earth😊

Trelino Evo has been a fantastic choice to simplify our camping experience.  We use it even at places that have a vault or pit toilet because doesn’t smell and is a much cleaner overall solution.  The simplicity of the design to keep urine separate is perfect

First of all, I like German engineering, and this portable toilet is just that. It's a neat, tidy application, a little on the small side, but very functional. I recommend trying it out a couple of times before actually using it, in our case, both a camper van and a small sailboat, where we replaced the cassette toilet that came with it. All in all, a good piece of kit for whatever your adventure.

What a wonderful composting toilet. And I use mine full time. People need to think what we are doing to our environment. And I never have to call a plumber. I’m disabled and the toilet is so lightweight and easy to clean. NO SMELL. I use it full time and clean it about every three days. They thought of everything, separate compartments for one and two and that is even contained in case it gets close to overflow. I use the bathroom more than the average person because of my disability. We’re thinking of buying one for the pontoon boat. I’m a grandma and my family and I are getting a small lot in the NC mountains, where we will put the RV, with all the grands we may get one for that property, lol who hates waiting. I would suggest this for one bathroom houses. Another thing the material it is made out of has not changed at all, using full time close to a year. I used a potty chair for a month and it was ruined the plastic material. I looked at some bigger Composting toilets, and you had to turn the lever and they’re extremely heavy and you have to take them apart. I was so thankful to find this toilet you will not go wrong buying it.
I’ve had my Trelino for a little over a year now. I use it full time and it’s awesome. Super sturdy, well made, compact, nothing leaks. I’m so happy with my purchase.
I’m a van lifer and this toilet has been an excellent product for my Van. Easy to keep clean and very functional!

I bought my Trelino in early 2024, and I absolutely love it. I am not a fulltime vanlifer, but my minivan camper is ready for adventure at all times. The small Trelino stows perfectly under my platform bed. When I set up camp, I fold out the bed platform's side tables and put the Trelino under the one by the van side door. It is super easy to access, including at 2 a.m. I travel with a medium-sized dog. I was leery of the bucket bathroom method touted by many YouTubers because I didn't want spills, smells or regular gross clean-ups. The amazing Trelino design solves all of those issues. Neither my pooch nor I are going to accidentally knock it over, and IT DOEN'T SMELL at all. I tell everyone about the Trelino. For women travelers, a Trelino gives a great amount of freedom on the road and in town. Even in major cities, there are too few safe, free, clean, accessible public toilets in the US. I believe every woman with a minivan should get one of these portable toilets. It's liberating.
The portable toilet works very well works exactly as your advertising. Thanks.

I couldn’t be happier with my personal Trelino composting toilet in our sprinter. I modified an existing cabinet to fit it, added a small spray bottle of vinegar mixture and a container of pet litter, added drawer slides - and voila- I have a my own bathroom ! No more dirty gas station bathrooms, no more stinky pit toilets and no more leaving a contaminated campsite. We didn’t want a dedicated bathroom or black water tank when we built out our van - but I was missing a convenient toilet - problem solved when I found the Trelino at a van trade show in SoCal 2023 !

I love my Trelino, quality is great. Simple to use. It was shipped efficiently. Came well packed. I wanted a quality toilet, easy to use, easy to keep clean, no fiddly bits to break. That is exactly what I got.

I dropped the lud toy unit and broke the cover for the hinge.  I experienced top notch customer service. Trelino has one of the best customer service teams I have experienced. Outstanding product as well.
Engineering and construction are sound, and the unit is simple to use and to empty and maintain.

I replaced a recirculating toilet iny camper van . Boy or boy that was a great improvement. No lingering smell we love it. We have used through out the summer and are well pleased with how it takes care of business.
Game changing toilet makes clean up a snap because solids and liquids are separated.

Trevino makes a well engineered & versatile product. I adapted mine for use in a cruising sailboat! It’s more compact and sanitary than a conventional marine toilet and eliminates hull openings, holding tanks and smell! Highly recommended!
easy purchase.  Basic & works well.
Good size and capacity not so oder free

I love that little composting toilet and have one in the van and one in the house. Our house has only one bathroom and when we have guests, more than one person often feels the urge at the same time... I love the semi self-closing, quiet lid and the simple elegant design. My only gripe is that the urine receptacle is not easy to completely empty out (not self-draining, when inverted), because of the shape of the top: a little liquid always remains, even when you turn it completely upside down. I empty it in the garden under a tree and immediately flush with water, so it's not a big issue, but there is room for improvement here. I've owned a big Sun Mar composting toilet for 25 years (bought for Y2K...), which has come in handy on occasion, but is a pain to empty and clean and needs it's own room, basically, which is not practical for us. The little Trelino is exactly what I was looking for.

I have had my Trelino composting toilet for a little over a year and it's been a gamechanger.  I am full time in my van and use it daily.  It's easy to empty and easy to keep clean.  I have never had an issue with odors and regularly empty everything.

Loving the Trelino product. I was a little worried at first about what I was getting for the cost. But I've used it for over a year now and appreciate the simplicity of design, ease of cleaning and disposal. Very discrete and streamlined look.

Great design, quality construction, and easy-to-use. We have the Evo-S in our Sprinter van, and the Evo-L in our Escape fiberglass travel trailer. The Evo-L replaced the traditional black-tank RV toilet. Been using ours since Oct and Dec 2023. The liquid-separating design is excellent, and the we notice only a woodsy smell from the combo coconut coir and compressed pine absorbant equine stall pellets. The urine container is easy to clean. Overall we cannot see us ever returning to a traditional RV toilet.
Great size, easy to use, looks good. We are a van builder and prefer the Trelino apposed to others due to its size, ease, and good looks.

I have used and purchased many different “waterless” or composting toilets over the years. I like my Trelino the best. It’s a little pricy, but I feel in the end the quality and comfort is worth it. I camp a lot and use mine all the time.

We are a full time van couple. We recently changed to the Trelino urine diverted toilet from a cassette toilet. The Trelino toilet is a much more user friendly way of life with the daily toilet needs over the cassette toilet. Very happy we made the change.
Delivery was prompt. Communication with customer service was amazing

We love our Trelino.  It is easy to use (even for a woman), easy to clean, and it is a perfect fit for our campervan.  We also like that it requires no electricity or venting, so there are no limits on where to place it in the van (or even outside of it).
Very comfortable to use.  Easy to clean.  However, it’s not easy to pick up.  Perhaps you could put in some finger holes or indents on the sides.

Sturdy toilet and comfortable. I found a tote that it fits into perfectly making it easy to move about. I like that I can use it as a step to get up onto the van’s bed. Super easy to clean out. I mostly only use for emergencies, and I’m using the biodegradable bags for #2. Very pleased with my purchase.

I have no complaints about their toilet. It is simple and not harmful for the environment. There’s plenty of camping toilet options out there and most of them are just overkill. You’d think it’s easy to find a simple toilet that does the only thing it needs to do but I was wrong. However, I’m glad I found Trelino.

We love our Trevino! We traded out our Campco for the Trelino 4 months and couldn’t be happier.  We have a converted van and the medium Trevino fits in our toilet/extra seat box with room to spare. The Trevino is sturdy, comfortable and well built, not tippy at all. The pee jugs fits into a plastic grocery bag along with the Lysol wipes and we can discreetly carry it into any restroom for dumping. The poo bag we tie up and dump in the garbage just like disposable diapers. We got an extra pee jug so we always have our Trelino ready to go. It takes a little bit to learn exactly where to sit to properly use the separator but the instruction booklet was very helpful. The 1:7 vinegar water solution works well to keep the pee jug scale free.  We travel in our van 6-9 months each year and the Trelino has really been a nice upgrade. Spendy but well worth it!

We are a family of four and have been looking for the perfect toilet for our sprinter van. We had been through a couple more common names, however they were not for us. Trelino checked every box and after over a year, it is still perfect! We love the ease of dumping the separate urine canister. We love the separate area for solids. We do use the porta paks in the urine canister and we have no smell issues. Toilet is very comfortable if you need to sit on it for a few minutes. We recommend our trelino to everyone!

We have had our Trelino for about a little over a year at this point. It's simple and comfortable to use, and easy to dispose of the waste. When used properly (with enough wood shavings/other material), it does not smell. We went with Trelino due to their price vs other composting toilets and highly recommend them. The shipping was fast, and the company is very responsive.

Never emptying a black tank again, thanks to Trelino! The solids/liquid separation works very, very well. I double bag the solids and just toss into trash after using. And having a sealed, leakproof liquid container gives me peace of mind while bouncing down the road on these poorly maintained interstates and roads here in the USA.  Even so, I don’t use the enclosed cap to seal the liquids canister and nothing splashes back through the “one-way only” liquids set up.  I appreciate the simplicity and functionality of such a basic , well constructed system. I may buy another one for dedicated use in the house, in order to conserve water usage since water and sewer bills for my sticks and bricks home is getting costly. Thank you Trelino for “keeping it simple”, and “making it smart”!

The product is great and I love the simplicity of a two compartment system toilet!! It is light and doesn't take up much space.  It is so easy to remove each compartment independently and rinse them out.  I also like the ability to lift out the entire toilet and rinse and sanitize the main toilet. It has made boondocking a much more convenient and sanitary way to contain what has been an unpleasant job!!

I have a large C-class motorhome with a macerating toilet. Besides being a water hog, there’s a lot of ways it can go kaput so I felt I needed a reliable backup. After a bit of research I decided on Trelino, and it has become my day-to-day toilet. It lives in the shower stall, and it’s so simple to move it for showering. Now I only use the built-in macerating toilet very occasionally just to keep the seals, etc lubricated. Needless to say, I am very pleased and impressed with my Trelino Evo!

I truly love my Trelino toilet! It replaced the regular toilet in my RV. The only issue I have with it is not being able to see the level of the urine container.  A window in to the container would be helpful. Also, if the seat section was hinged it would make it easier to access the 2 containers in the base without having to take the whole top off. Other than those 2 things, it works great, is easy to clean and use.
The toilet is very simple to use, its an excellent design. We use it in our RV and it works well for us in that application.

We have been using our Trelino full time for 9 months now and we couldn’t be more happy with our purchase. This is by far the best composting toilet on the market. It’s small, compact, easy to use and best part is it’s easy to clean. The seat is molded, so there is no nooks and crannies to get into. Just spray and wipe clean, no need to worry about massive cleaning. It’s just so easy to clean after each use. And then just bag it and throw in the appropriate bin. Just make sure you order the Urin plug with your purchase. It should come standard but doesn’t. And it makes a big difference. We are full time travellers and comment all the time how happy we are with this composting toilet. Thanks Trelino, for making a great product.
I have been using Trelino origin for about a year now. It is so suitable for my Vanlife. I really like their brand of tree shaving as compost material as well. It works great. Thanks Trelino
We are so happy with our Trelino toilet.  No more chemicals!  No more smells! The toilet is sturdy yet comfortable.  It fits under the couch in our van and emptying is super convenient

We'd been looking for a waterless toilet to retrofit into our commercially built van. Aside from Trelino being one of just a couple that would fit, we chose it because 1) build quality 2) option for various capacities (we went with large and are glad) 3) no electricity required 4) No proprietary, expensive bags to purchase (though they offer waste bags, we bought some compostable ones online) 5) easy to dispose waste and clean components I contacted customer service prior to purchase for a question about their return policy and when I forgot to add my promo code at purchase. Both times, I received a response within 24 hours. We have about three months of full-time use and will never go back. We have so many more (free) options for waste disposal. Highly recommend the company and product.
I use the Trelino Evo S in my little fiberglass egg trailer.  It is a perfect fit, lightweight, odorless and easy to empty.  Much better than a chemical portable toilet. Two thumbs up!
OMG this Toilet was perfect for me. I brought it to a camping trip and I couldn’t believe how many days and nights of urine it could hold. Amazing. I love how the solids are separate. I love mine!

Easy ordering and fast shipping. The Trelino Evo came well packaged and is a great product. So far we’ve used it on multiple road trips and it’s held up remarkably well. If you are looking for a simple bathroom solution, this is a great option.

5 Stars includes the customer service level of Trelino. The unit itself is perfectly simple. It stores easy, can be moved around easily and used in your camper, tent or trailer. You can also deployable shower/restroom tent. The bags make disposal easy. No batteries, power unit, solar generator or hook up required. It cannot be any easier. The unit is tough too. Not cheaply built. Its sturdy but light. Everyone has to "go" when camping, the Trelino makes it convenient, clean and private.

We have the Medium Evo Toilet which both my wife and I use while van camping. If we did it again, we’d get the Large as we sometimes have to empty the urine container more than once in a day. If you are a single traveler or use other facilities for most of your bathroom needs, then a medium (or small) might be sufficient. We love the size, weight and waterproof containment of waste compared to other portable toilets we’ve owned. Other than the urine container volume being too small for us, we think this is a very good product.

The toilet and supplies from Trelino arrived promptly. We have used the toilet for several camping trips and it is even better than we thought it would be because it is so easy to use and clean.  There is also no smell.

The order was easy and delivery was quick.  IMO, the Trelino is well built, simple easy to use and extremely easy to empty compared to its competitors.  The fact that it is half the price of its competitors is a huge bonus. Installation is as simple as setting it in place.  It makes camping in our van conversion so much more comfortable for my wife and I.

After researching small composting toilets for our ford transit converted van I decided on the reeling medium. Took a 3 week road trip and it was great! I use a squatty potty stool at home, so the height of this toilet is perfect. Easy to empty and keep clean. The materials are high quality. The size is also perfect for the van. For 2 people using it you do have to empty the liquids container daily with the medium size, but the solids could go quite a while I think(we usually did that at a rest stop though). The price does seem a little high for something made from all plastic, but I would still buy it compared with all the others I researched

Trelino works great.  Recommend looking at a way to make the base a little more stable.  And, for RV traveling, it would help to make or have a unit that’s a little more rugged.  Oh, forgot maybe recess for handles would help with moving the unit around.
I Love my Trelino! I had another Popular toilet but my Trevino works for girls (most toilets are made for boys in my honest opinion. I love its portability, comfort…all the Things

I like the compact camp toilet.  Everything fit into it and stays put.  I camp in a 5x10 conversion, so, space is a premium.  The separator makes this FAR superior then the dug fox hole or the lugaloo.  It has been given the wife's seal of approval. The reason for a 4 is because of the shipping/delivery issues I endured.  What was suppose to have been a 2 week delivery, took way longer. 5 Star for the product, -1 for hard to reach customer service.

I live in Florida and have problems with liquid forming in the bottom of the case. I guess this is from condensation in this humid climate. I have put both containers in plastic bags and this has reduced the liquid collection some but not fully. I just recently got some hospital absorbent pads but have not used them yet. I also ordered some double bubble insulation and plan on lining the interior of the case with this. For years I used a C-Head on my boat and never experienced this problem. I assume that was because the hull was in the water lowering the temperature at floor level. I really like the principle of design but this liquid collection is turning me off.
supplier_response: Thank you for sharing your experience! In humid climates like Florida, a fan might be a good solution to help transport moisture out and improve air circulation. This could significantly reduce the liquid buildup in the case. Please reach out to our support team so we can look into this further and find the best solution for your situation. If needed, we can also arrange to send you a fan!

review_text: Got a trelino for our tiny home/ trailer build, but currently using it in our basement to save us going upstairs during the night to use the washroom. So we use the #2 bucket as a garbage for now. Really great, easy to use and empty. We find it's hard to get the scale buildup out of the tank even with vinegar or bleach. After a year we decided to order some replacement silicone pieces but they seem like a thinner silicone and doesn't seal like the original. ; Therefore, doesn't help with smell. When the trelino is closed there is no smell, just when open. Maybe a new tank will help this, not sure. But overall we like it :) and we'd recommend!

Happy with our Trelino.  Very functional toilet, but as much as we regularly clean using vinegar and other cleaning products there is still a smell of urine.   You need the pee plug to help.  Pooping section is fine.  Its better than the other basic portable toilets out there. But this one is more expensive.

I purchased one of these for my off grid studio away from the house plumbing as I don’t need to break my work concentration for long walks to a bathroom.   Read tons of positive reviews that i agree with 100%! I got the shortest model in gray. Just looks like a box without signaling “toilet”. Separates extremely well and so easy to use and clean And comfy to sit on its wide rim. Vinegar spray works fabulously.  Love it!
Our Trelino is the best!  We have used it for a year now and it is super easy to use, dispose, and keep clean.  One of the best decisions in our van build.

First! I made a mistake on my order, messaged support & within a short time they fixed/refunded me the correction. Love that! Second, the product is beyond simplistic, super user friendly. My ONLY reason for 4 stars is it can be a little uncomfortable on the bum but I managed & truthfully not sure this could be fixed without taking away the ideal small size.

Lightweight yet sturdy. Easy to use. I combine mine with Lunderg Toilet Bowl Liners with Super Absorbent Pads that I can order from Amazon. I can then easily dispose of the bags in any trash can along the road without a hint of odor.

I absolutely love my trelino  toilet. It has made traveling in my van so much more enjoyable. From the solid design and The comfortable seat not even to mention the urine diverting design makes things so much simpler and easier to manage waste disposal. I would recommend this product to anyone who is traveling and in need of having a portable toilet solution.

I had a very negative experience with this store. I ordered rims using their configurator, which indicated they were compatible with my car. The size also matched my stock rims. After placing the order, their support team contacted me to confirm my brake disc size. I provided the details, they confirmed compatibility, and proceeded with shipping. Only after dispatch did they send the TÜV certificate—which clearly stated that the rims are not compatible with my car. I immediately tried to stop the shipment, but customer service did not respond. I also attempted to call multiple times but was unable to reach a human representative. As a result, the rims were delivered anyway. Since then, I have been trying to arrange a return. Customer service initially acknowledged that they made a mistake regarding compatibility, but then stopped responding altogether. I have now been waiting over two weeks for a return label, with no resolution in sight. Overall, the “Passend-Garantie” they advertise does not appear to be genuine. The company seems unable to handle situations that fall outside standard processes. A very disappointing experience.

This time, however, an order that was clearly shown and confirmed as four complete wheels was later disputed by the seller, who claimed it included only one complete wheel and three rims. Despite providing screenshots, the issue was not acknowledged and the order was changed without my request. A refund was eventually issued. Mistakes happen — the handling and communication could have been much better.

The ordering process was very simple and easy. I really like that specifications are confirmed by vehicle type. The wheel and tire set look fantastic. TPMS paired without issue. My only complaint is that if a set of black rims are ordered and bolts are sent with it. They should be matching color. Black rims with silver bolts doesn’t look right. I hope someone can get back to me and fix this..I’ll update this when this is addressed.

I have ordered a set of 4 rims and tires fitted on them. I went to my local workshop to have them mounted. Right away, I noticed very strong vibrations in my car at 120 km/h. I went back to the workshop and they did a re-balancing. The vibrations reduced but they were still present. I issued a complaint and noticed that also they sent me the wrong size for the centering rings. I asked them to send me the correct size 2 times as I scheduled another appointment for re-balancing. Since then, for 2 weeks already I was not able to get in touch with anyone from felgenoutlet. I ended up buying another set of centering rings and then went for another rebalancing. The issue is still present up to this day. Completely unsatisfied, I urge you to avoid them. Update 1 month after their last reply: I was able to fix the wheels, I have sent the proof the shop asked for but heard nothing from them in 1 month. I have contacted the consumer protection.
