review_text: Ordered part for vehicle. Site said it was suitable for vehicle. Part wrong size for vehicle. Contacted Autodoc and they said return it but at my cost. The cost of return would have been more than item, convenient for them to avoid any returns, shipping had been charged already to be supplied incorrect part. Wouldn't recommend this company as they make a mistake and you bear the cost.  Follow up from Autodoc to my complaint was to supply the correct part at no further cost but they say you have to supply original part number or vin number to confirm correct part selection. Seems that there system doesn't link vin to registration number which seems strange! As for supplying OEM numbers are not practical to do on some items as this means the vehicle would be unusable while waiting for parts, not really a reasonable thing to do for most people. I eventually received the correct part at no extra cost after customer care got involved. The customer care were very good and keen to keep me happy. I received a voucher as a good will gesture also. I still think they need to rethink their policy on   wrong parts supplied as they are the experts and when it says it fits your vehicle then it  doesn't, it should not cost you anything to return and to charge an extra premium on shipping terms to avoid this isn't acceptable. I have changed my rating to ok but will be careful of ordering anything that I need urgently. Again I was treated well by customer care.

review_text: Poor dispatch times and customer support for this order.I have ordered with Autodoc many times before and in 3 different countries, the parts and packaging are very good and generally the order comes within 2 weeks. Payment was taken out of my bank on Wednesday the 1st of May but it took until the evening of the 7th of May for the parts to be dispatched. I contacted Autodoc customer support today the 13th of May as I was concerned that the last entry on the Tracking from the courier was made at 7pm on the 7th of May. I asked the customer support agent if they could contact GLS on my behalf to confirm that they actually had the parcel, as when I contacted GLS this morning I was told that only the ticket had been produced and they did not have the parcel. All the customer support agent did was copy the link to the parcel tracking that said it was in Germany to me and said I would have to wait till tomorrow or Wednesday for the parcel tracking to be updated. I am now left to wait, hoping that the Parcel is going to come but not knowing whether GLS actually have it or not. When I contacted customer support I at least expected them to contact the delivery company to confirm that my Parcel was on route and not lost.EditThe Parcel arrived Today the 14th of May. It was as usual well Packaged, I just wish that when I contacted the customer service they could have checked the tracking for me so that I knew that the parcel wasn't lost in transit rather than just telling me to wait and see!

review_text: For the second time I have used this website it WILL be my last. Firstly the items show up as in stock but shipping wasn't made until 8 days later. Over three weeks later and I'm still waiting. Secondly the items I ordered were a recognised quality brand Magneti Marelli but after paying for the items I got an email with an alternate unknown brand called "spark". THIS IS NOT WHAT I PAID FOR! No quality, no stock, no prompt delivery, no reliability, no honesty, if you need to fix your car please go anywhere else, this is a complete waste of time.UPDATE: Parts now received.I have been emailed by AUTODOC twice now, offering an apology and the possibility to return my items in exchange for the original items I had ordered at their cost. They claim that this will take more time however to source the parts, again I say that on their website it shows as "in stock", it clearly is not. I was told that the parts were swapped for "STARK" parts because it would be quicker for me, adding that they would not do this to me in any future purchases. Having read several forums on this, it seems this is common practice with AUTODOC and they will exchange parts without notice. If it were a cheap like for like part then I would accept it no questions. This is not a sustainable business model, I hope AUTODOC will take this as constructive criticism and develop a form of integrity so as to respect and honour their customers choices and reasonable expectations. I am grateful that they offered to exchange the parts at their expense, however I cannot go any longer without my car.

review_text: Upd.  10/18/2022Changed rating +1 star. Special thanks to Alex, who supported me from the German office (at his request, I am writing an update). Details belowOn the 3rd week, I unexpectedly received a letter from autodoc support that my order was delayed and I was given a coupon for 3 euros. The most interesting thing (I don't remember for sure ) is that this letter arrived just on the day when the goods were delivered to me.Despite this, I started a correspondence with support. The summary of the correspondence: thanks for the coupon, but I'm not going to order from you anymore, because your service is s h i t. At some point, an employee of the quality department from Germany joined in, who tried to smooth the situation.Through a series of correspondence with Alex (support from German), the value of the coupon was increased from 3 euros to 20 euros and with Alex's personal assistance in the following purchases. He also explained the reason for the delay. I, in turn, explained that I, as a client, I'm not interested in their problems. We agreed that the company will work on its mistakes.IMHO:- regarding the autodoc: let's see if I do order something. I will look at other competitors- my personal: no matter what country you are in, but if you don’t stand up for your rights and demand the best quality that you pay for, you will use s h i t t y service all the time we all should work on our improvementsOriginal commentPlaced an order and paid for it on Monday (September 05) after 14:00. Today (September 13) the status is "Order is awaiting receipt by the carrier". That is, 1 working week has passed from the moment of the order to the moment of its transfer to the postal service. I am silent about how long the delivery itself will take place.In fact, starting from the 3rd day, my order changed its status every day (it’s a pity that the client has no way to track this in the system). There was nothing unique in the order, at the time of ordering and payment all the goods were in stock, no one contacted me to say that there were difficulties and the formation of the order would take a whole week.At the same time, the website indicates that the order will be sent within 24-48 hours.Honestly, I do not understand how this is possible today for a large integrator when we all strive to speed up the delivery of goods/services to customers.  And I understand that I don’t have much choice but to go to some local store and buy what I need.I recently moved to Portugal, but in this service, I went back 10-15 years in the past. Perhaps this is normal for Portugal, but the company needs to improve this service

This review is for the company Autodoc or autoteiledirekt.de (they seem to operate under a bunch of different names, so I posted here and on Autodoc reviews).The short version: Absolutely terrible customer service, bordering on a scam. Order somewhere else!The very long one for those who care:I ordered a bunch of parts from them and to be fair the items are what I expected and do their jobs but 2 days after the items were supposed to be at my house (shipped inside Germany so no excuse there) I called them up and after pretty unfriendly interaction with their customer service guy I got promised that it would go out that day. So, if it says 2 days, expect a week.While I was talking to him I noticed the parts where now 30 Euros cheaper on a 200 Euro order and I asked him for a deal. I would have taken store credit, even a complimentary sponge or a packet of gummy bears or something that showed any interest in their customers, but he wasn't willing to budge. Fair enough there too, they don't have to.So, I told him I would just order the stuff again and return the first package and since they already delivered the parts too late for me I had all the time in the world (second package was late by the same time frame too). I even bought their safe order (sicher bestellen) feature on the first order, which states that I can return the uninstalled parts for a full refund for any reason within a 100 days or something like that. Since the boxes are just sitting here and haven’t even been opened it shouldn't have been a problem.A week after I filed for the return I haven't even gotten a mail saying that it is being processed other than their automated instant reply so I called them up again. I didn’t even get an answer the first 4 times I called even though it kept telling me constantly I was next in line. After 15 Minutes and 27 Seconds you get dropped from the line each time so you get to try again. I have a headset and plenty of time while i was doing other things so I just kept calling. Even tried calling them from 3 lines at once (I got bored) and you get the same message on all of them. That was around 10am on a regular business day. Never got through to anyone then so I tried again in the afternoon and after the second round of waiting I actually got someone who couldn't even say hello or good bye or anything and I tried my best to be extra friendly. I got some results in the form of six emails (one for each part I ordered) saying my return was accepted and an attached PDF Return Form for every part. Seemed like progress but it also said that my return mailers would come in separate emails which still haven't arrived 5 days later.I guess I will listening to some more annoying music and automated messages next week. At this point I fully expect them to either not answer at all or at best be extremely rude again. Chances of me getting the full refund, that their extra safe order service promises are slim to none and I bet they will give me the full runaround for that too.Calling it what it is at this point is a Scam.I will change this review accordingly if they manage to surprise me and not do any of that, after all terrible service and late deliveries aren't a scam if the parts are what you bought but at this point it sure looks like a Scam when it comes to their return policies and safe order options.Update (26.06.2018):I guess complaining loudly on the internet does help since their english speaking customer service called me up first thing monday and sent me the return mailer (just one though even though I got two boxes but since they already had all the heavy stuff in one box and the 2 super light things in a seperate one I figured they might as well go in a single box. Didn't want to argue over this but I took a bunch of pictures anyway). The english speaking customer service rep was very nice, which was a welcome change so I guess I'll be carefully optimistic and wait.Update (09.07.2018):Turns out they actually did send me three labels - in yet again three separate emails - just two ended up in spam. I guess since it took 40something emails (not even kidding) to get to this point. So I sent the three packages in the same arrangement they came here and apparently they received them on Jul. 2nd. Still waiting to hear anything further. Don't hold your breath on getting your money in any sort of timely fashion back. Mind you I started the Process over a month ago on June 3rd. I do realize the return proves and banks and all that take their sweet time too. I don't have a problem with that, but this is just ridiculous. How does a company with that terrible of a customer service stay in business these days? I've head better customer service from Indian tech support scammers than these guys. I’m curious what happens next. My guess is I do get some money back at some point or another but not even close to the amount I paid with all kinds of bogus charges and “service” fees as a justification. I guess we will see.

This is my review following my installation of two rear, complete strut assemblies for my 2013 Cayenne Diesel (with standard suspension).The reason I am giving these struts only 2 stars is because although the parts looked like decent quality when they arrived, (a) they were extremely difficult to install, and (b) the rear ride height is now higher by about 2.5 inches than the front.I believe the Aerosus replica strut assemblies are longer than the OEMs but, I cannot be absolutely sure because I did not measure them against the OEMs I removed.   Why?   Because both of the rear springs on the OEMs had broken so any measurement would not have been accurate.However, if I could post pictures on this review, you - the reader  - can judge for yourself WHETHER the rear ride height looks normal.  With the OEMs, there was no differential ... I believe ... and even if there was, it was not noticeable to the naked eye.Look, maybe the Aerosus replicas will "settle down"  as the company claims.  If it does, then, I will retract this review and post a new one.  For now, this review is accurate

review_text: Hello all, I just need to leave my feedback for an ordered placed by Monday 21/07/2025. I order it and Thursday it comes the courier to leave the package as UPS informed but there was nobody at home and also the courier didn’t left any note or advice that he passed by. After figuring out via track and trace they mentioned on the tracker the package will be delivered next day by Friday. Waiting for the package next they Friday, UPS uploaded the status of my package as damaged. Straight away I have called to customer service from NL and a lady names Kasia she attended me saying that she received an email from UPS with information the package is damaged. I told her to send me another package with all same items if those ones are damaged. She told me that the rules are different ones and that I have to wait until the package will arrive back to the warehouse for evaluation and then I will receive my money back, in the meantime I can order again paying of course for the second time. I explained her in the phone that is not fear that I should solve this situation spending money from my pocket for some items I didn’t even receive and she told me that these are the rules and she cannot do nothing about it. Now my question is, why the customer service didn’t want to cancel my order knowing there is a problem with a damage package, also explained her on the phone that the car is dismantled on the garage and every day I have to spend money for keeping the car there because it’s about water pump and the dual mass from the gear box. The only response I have received it was that Che cannot talk to me anymore because I do not want to understand the rules she explained me on the phone and above mentioned on this complaint. I hope somebody from Motointegrator that supervise the orders can give an answer to this because when I asked lady Kasia for a supervisor or somebody who’s has power to decide she said that there is nobody who can help me. In my opinion this lady shouldn’t work anymore on customer service.
supplier_response: Dear customer, Thank you very much for your detailed explanation. We are truly sorry to hear that your experience with our delivery and customer service has been so disappointing. We fully understand how frustrating this situation must be for you, especially given the urgent need for the parts and the costs you are incurring as a result. Unfortunately, in the event of damage during transport, we are dependent on the return procedure of the carrier, in this case UPS. According to the applicable procedures, we can only process a refund or a new shipment after the damaged package has been returned and received by us. However, we understand that this procedure is not ideal in situations such as yours, where time and clarity are crucial. We regret that you felt you were not heard in your conversation with our colleague, but in her defence, I can only say that she and the entire customer service team are highly competent. She gave you the best solution within her capabilities. I would like to add that the company is now so large that it is no longer possible to quickly complete a new order from the warehouse. The warehouse is fully automated. Processes that have been set in motion must run their course as they are. Perhaps this is not so much about the rules we have to follow, but rather the procedures that cannot be interrupted in such a large company. Customer service works online from home. And my colleagues in customer service are very competent and friendly. I hope you can understand this. We would still like to help you as best we can. If you have any further questions or requests, please contact us again so that we can see if we can still arrange something for you within the existing possibilities. Kind regards, Susanne

review_text: I’ve ordered several times from Autodoc. The order included, among others, two similar items — one of which arrived in an open package and missing components.I filed a complaint, and the first solution offered was a compensation for the incomplete part in exchange of me accepting the part, which I refused because I needed the full product. Autodoc then informed me that I would have to return the part through a postal office and wait up to six weeks for a replacement.This is unacceptable — I had already paid in advance, received an incomplete product, and now would need to wait another 3–6 weeks for a replacement. Awful customer service and unreasonable return/replacement policies.I have submitted an official complaint and will escalate the case to the European Consumer Centre and Consumer Protection authorities as it looks to me as an abusive approach from Autodoc related to replacement of uncompliant products. Their mistake, but they take no responsibility and no risk to solve the situation. It is simply not acceptable to wait a total of 4–7 weeks from the initial order to receive the correct items.It is the customer that takes all the risk and headaches in a commercial relationship with Autodoc. They charge you in advance,  there is a high level of luck implied to receive all parts complete and undamaged, if there is a problem and you need something replaced you need to take the item to la postal office, wait until received and inspected by Autodoc, then wait a new delivery, hopefully with the right and compliant product… they take absolutely no accountability in this process it is only customer’s money and nerves…I advise avoiding Autodoc and choosing alternative suppliers with more customer-oriented policies and responsive support.

According to European legislation, the core charge is the amount that the manufacturer requires as a deposit to guarantee the old spare part is returned for remanufacturing. The core charge is refunded when the old spare part is returned. This information can be easily found on our website under ''Core Exchange'' or ''Stomavgift'' for the Swedish version of our site. Also there it is stated that the return of the old part is to be made at the customer's expenses. Thank you for your understanding! Best regards, Autodoc Team

Unfortunately, I cannot recommend dackonline.se based on my experience.I ordered a complete set of winter wheels on November 9th, with a promised delivery time of a maximum of 14 working days. This deadline passed by several weeks without me receiving any clear explanation. During this period, I was given conflicting information every time I called customer service – sometimes they claimed the tires couldn’t be delivered and tried to get me to cancel the order, while other times they promised that the wheels would be shipped “this week or next week.” None of it was true.At the same time, the exact same wheel package continued to be shown as “available” on their website, which felt both misleading and unprofessional.The customer service by phone cannot make any decisions at all; they only act as intermediaries and constantly refer to “the other department” that responds by email. This creates a Catch-22 situation – the phone support can’t help, and the email support doesn’t reply in time.Now they have also informed me that the product I ordered is sold out, despite it being listed as available during my entire waiting period. I have been forced to try to solve the issue myself, contact the Consumer Agency, and argue for an alternative, even though the fault lies entirely with them.It is extremely frustrating as a customer to have to chase answers, be transferred around, and receive different information with every contact. Especially when winter tires are legally required in Sweden and you depend on receiving your delivery on time.I recommend buying from a more reliable supplier that can actually keep their delivery times and provide consistent information to their customers.

review_text: Just terrible customer service...Ordered two times with Dackonline.se, two times they messed it up.First time (Q3 2024) the tires were send to a forwarding company in Germany instead delivered to DPD/PostNord and were stuck there for weeks until the forwarding company just send them back.Event though I called dackonline.se every day and was promised they fix it, it never happened. Finally after the tires were returned they send a new order. Which arrived few weeks later, one tire at a time over 4 weeks. And two of them to the wrong address and I had to pick them up myself at a PostNord delivery center. Which was difficult, since the name on the parcel was the tire shop, not me.Anyway, now (Q1 25) I ordered 4 Michelin summer tires and again... they messed it up. Instead of getting the 4 tires I ordered I got two of the ones I ordered and two total different ones. Different, brand, dimensions and type. I called in to get it exchanged and then mess really started.I got a pickup order for the wrong tires but in that pick up order the type was wrongly specified. I send a mail to please correct it and then I got another mail that they will pick up the four tires I ordered. I wrote again "please pick up only two tires of type XYZ". And I got an "ok, we will pick up the four Michelin tires". It seems the customer service doesn't even read the messages.My tone went from friendly to really annoyed and told them to carefully read my messages and organize a pick up of the two wrong tires, not of four Michelin tires. They replied with a message "we fix it for you". Only to be followed by another message "oh, we come on Friday and pick up the 4 Michelin tires".I will now hand the PostNord pick-up the two wrong tires and see where this leads me.I am at a loss for words for such incompetence.And by the way... calling them you will need to have a loooooot of time.Never again.

supplier_response: Dear Thomas G., thank you very much for your feedback and for taking the time to share your experience with us. We're pleased to hear that you were satisfied with the ordering process and the efficient delivery — it's always our goal to ensure a smooth experience for our customers. We exclusively offer brand-new tires from current production. However, since the tires are dispatched directly after your order depending on availability from various warehouses across Germany, the specific DOT number of a given tire cannot be determined in advance due to system constraints. Please note that, over time, proper storage can actually improve certain material properties. This is because the rubber compound in the tires continues to cure and is not immediately exposed to the stresses of road use. According to the BRV (German Tire Retail and Vulcanization Trade Association), tires are considered "factory-new" for up to 3 years and "new" for up to 5 years, provided they have been stored correctly. We appreciate your honesty and your 3-star rating, and we hope to welcome you again in the future under even better circumstances. Kind regards Reifendirekt Team

review_text: Worst experience ever. I ordered a set of winter tires on November 3rd. Their policy asks to allow 8 to 9 days after order date for delivery. The reply came 2 days later asking me if I had received the tires, which up to today I still haven't. I have written several emails and even through their WhatsApp system to which I still have not received any answer. On the 23rd of November I went to PayPal to request my full refund. As per PayPal policy I have to allow them to respond until December 12. I am still waiting on a resolution after spending 800 euros with this company. I was simply trying to save 60 euros for the same tires at another website and now it's costing even more as I will have to pursue with my attorney. These people are ridiculous, you call their number and exactly after 10 minutes on hold you receive an automated message saying to call them again because they're busy. I mean, how many employees do they have? Only 1?!?! Please avoid these company as they will simply get your money and you will not receive your goods nor a simple response about the status.

One of my old tires were leaking air, the tyres were near end of life so instead of trying to repair it I decided to order 4 new tyres.The tyres arrived at the installation partner and where installed on the car. So far so good.Two days later one of the new tyres were flat again. I returned to the installation partner, and they could now tell me that the problem was the rim, not the tyre, and that I should by a new rim.I went  back online and bought a new rim according to the car model by following the guide on the webside. The rim arrived at the partner and they put on the tyre. Then when they tried to put it on the car, it turns out that it does not fit although it has all the right dimensions. They advise me to contact dekkonline.com.I contact dekkonline and they tell me that they will not take back a rim after it has been tried to put on the car!!! My question to them is then how would you know that it does not fit until you put it on the car, as long as I have ordered according to their process? It is my problem that the product I have ordered does not fit the car!!! And they suggest that I order a new rim at my own expense. Then I ask them how I can make sure that a new rim will fit the car, as long as the one I have ordered already have the right specs on the parameters you can choose on the site.This basically leaves me with a car I can not drive, money spent on a rim that does not fit, and absolutely no support from dekkonline as to how they can help.
supplier_response: Dear Mr Gavlen, Thank you for your review. We wish to inform you that the guide on our website for ordering is not a guaranteed size. That is the recommendation we receive from the manufacturers. If you are uncertain about the size of rims or tires you need for your vehicle it is always advised to check your vehicle documents where you have all the information listed. In addition we wish to inform you that if the tire has been mounted on the rim or has been attempted to be mounted on the car we unfortunately can not take it back as it is considered used. Best regards, Your dekkonline.com team.
